Body.Content:
Starting June 1, 2018, we will migrate the GUIDs of zone-redundant snapshots and images for managed disks from Locally Redundant Storage GUIDs to Zone Redundant Storage GUIDs. There won’t be a pricing impact from this change, but you will need to modify billing routines that rely on the resource GUID.

See the following table for GUID migration details.
